import unreal
worlds=[]
for world in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.World):
    path=world.get_path_name()
    if 'UEDPIE' not in path and '/Game/' not in path: continue
    actors=[]
    niagara=[]
    for actor in unreal.GameplayStatics.get_all_actors_of_class(world, unreal.Actor):
        try:
            label=actor.get_actor_label()
            cls=actor.get_class().get_name()
            if 'SSPR' in label or 'Niagara' in cls or actor.get_components_by_class(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
                actors.append({'label':label,'class':cls,'path':actor.get_path_name()})
            for comp in actor.get_components_by_class(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
                asset=comp.get_editor_property('asset')
                niagara.append({'owner':label,'component':comp.get_path_name(),'asset':asset.get_path_name() if asset else None,'active':bool(comp.is_active())})
        except Exception: pass
    worlds.append({'world':path,'actors':actors,'niagara':niagara})
print('M2A_WORLDS='+repr(worlds))
